eyebrow.zh: 本地运行 · 无需云端 · 单二进制

headline.zh:
让 Qwen3.8 塞进你的 Mac
只损失个位数吞吐
headline.en:
Fit Qwen3.8 in your Mac
Lose only single-digit throughput

sub.zh: EngramTier 探测 Qwen3.8 的 24GB n-gram 表中哪些条目你真正在用，把冷数据搬到 SSD，让模型住进本地内存。
sub.en: EngramTier profiles which entries of Qwen3.8's 24GB n-gram table your workload actually hits, then offloads the cold majority to SSD so the model fits in local RAM.

body.zh: 一条命令生成 Pareto 报告：前 10% 的 key 占了多少次查询。如果分布稀疏，SSD 分层就有意义。
body.en: One command generates a Pareto report: what fraction of lookups the top 10% of keys account for. If the distribution is sparse, SSD tiering makes sense.

title.zh: 冷数据搬走，热数据留下
title.en: Cold entries out, hot entries stay

body.zh: mmap 把冷的 n-gram 条目映射到 SSD，热区留在 RAM。LRU 保证热数据常驻内存，冷数据按需加载。
body.en: mmap maps cold n-gram entries to SSD while the hot set stays in RAM. An LRU cache keeps frequently accessed entries resident and loads cold ones on demand.

body.zh: m1 先跑基准确认稀疏性假设成立，再投入完整实现。不稀疏就停——不浪费第二个周末。
body.en: m1 runs a benchmark to confirm the sparseness assumption before investing in the full implementation. If the table isn't sparse, you stop — no wasted weekends.

body.zh: 单机 profiler 永久免费开源。多机 EngramTier Team（遥测、集中配置、横向对比）走付费路线。
body.en: The single-host profiler is free and open source forever. Multi-box EngramTier Team (telemetry, central config, cross-host comparison) is the paid path.
